@claude What are the Eden Project's opening hours in December, and is it open on Saturday 12 December 2026? Also, do they have any December events or closures I should know about? It's in Cornwall, UK.

I couldn't confirm Eden's daytime hours for December. The Christmas page says the Biomes close to day visitors at 3.15pm, which suggests an early close. Saturday 12 December looks open, and it's a Christmas Lights evening (about 4 to 8.30pm). Lights are off 24 and 25 December. Check [edenproject.com opening times](https://edenproject.com/visit/opening-times) and the [Christmas page](https://www.edenproject.com/visit/whats-on/christmas-at-the-eden-project) before booking flights.

@claude Is there a bus or taxi from Newquay Airport to the Eden Project, and roughly how long does it take?

Yes to both, though I only found travel-guide sources, not official timetables. A taxi takes about 30-45 minutes and costs roughly £45-65. A bus is possible, with a change at St Austell, but it takes around 2 hours or more. For a 4pm slot, a taxi is the safer choice. Check live times before booking.
